subject_line: Application for Software Engineer (Freshers) — Ayushkumar Burde
body:
Ayushkumar Burde is a Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience building RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI. This role appeals because it requires building backend services with Python frameworks and implementing RESTful APIs.

Delivered RESTful API endpoints for three backend modules at CrystalTech Services using Node.js and Express.js. Built a client inventory management system using React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, handling authentication and database schema design.

I bring production-ready backend and frontend experience to this team. Let’s discuss how I can contribute to your engineering goals.
